learning_outcomes.text: Knows the role of the cutting tool in machining and the effects of cutting conditions on the cutting tool.
It determines the right cutting tool for good machining performance and efficient production.

syllabus_topics: Function of Cutting Tools in Machining - Relationship between workpiece - Cutting Tool - Machine Tool - Chip Removal Mechanics - Chip Formation - Types of Cutting Tools

Machinability Concept and Machinability Parameters 
Hiphen Definition of machinability 
Hiphen Criteria that determine machinability 
Hiphen Factors affecting machinability 
Hiphen Effect of workpiece material properties on machinability

Effects of Cutting Parameters on Machining Process 
Hiphen Cutting speed/speed effect 
Hiphen Impact of progress 
Hiphen Effect of depth of cut 
Hiphen Chip geometry

Cutting Tool Geometry, Effect of Angles on Performance 
Question mark Effect of rake angle, clearance angle and wedge angle on machining performance 
Question mark Tools with negative and positive geometry 
Question mark Effect of insert radius on machining performance

5. Cutting Tool Materials and Coating Methods 
Question mark Cutting tool material types 
Question mark Cutting tool material usage areas/conditions 
Question mark Coating Types 
Question mark Effects of coating properties on cutting performance
Cutting Fluids Used in Machining - Duties of Cutting Fluids - Classification of Cutting Fluids - Application Methods of Cutting Fluids
Geometric Tolerance and Surface Quality in Machining - Geometric (Dimensional) Tolerance - Surface quality - Factors Affecting Dimensional Tolerance and Surface Quality
Chip Geometry and Factors Affecting Chip Geometry - Chip formation and chip geometry - Factors affecting chip formation (form)
Thermal and Mechanical Loads Affecting the Cutting Tool - Forces Affecting the Cutting Tool - Heat Generated in the Cutting Tool
Wear on Cutting Tools - Wear Mechanisms and Load Factors - Wear Types (Types) - Control (Measurement) of Tool Wear
Cutting Tool Life Models and Machining Economics - Cutting Tool Life Models - Processing Economics
Cutting Tool and Tool Holder Selection - ISO tool norms according to workpiece material - Cutter and Tool Holder Types and Standards

Tooling Design and Production Methods - Existing tools used in industry - Cutting tool design and production methods - CAD/CAE (Computer Aided Design/Computer Aided Engineering) Programs used in cutting tool design

Machine Information, Birsen Publishing House, Istanbul, 2006.
Mikell P. Groover, Principles of Modern Manufacturing, Nobel Publications.
